name: KEN THE 390
description: '''Ken the 390''' (stylized as '''KEN THE 390'''; born Takeshi Sakuma on June 17, 1981) is a Japanese rapper, songwriter, and music director from [[Machida, Tokyo]]. He began performing in 1999 and built a reputation through club performances and [[Freestyle battles|freestyle MC battles]] before releasing his first solo album, ''Prologue'', in 2006. He later established the independent label DREAM BOY in 2011. Beyond his solo recording career, KEN THE 390 has worked in television, anime, artist development, and stage productions.
